# P37.49 — Federal datasets family (R11-ACQ-21)

Round-11 row 474 · `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/474_P37.49__federal-datasets-family.md live_verification=false` · base `r11/P37.48-aggregate-lanes`

## What this is

The I8 §6.2 **federal datasets family**: one fetch-and-parse helper —
stdlib CSV / XLSX stream / JSON bodies plus index-page link enumeration —
with small per-dataset adapters, wired behind the gate to the eight
ACQ-21 registry seats: the US Courts §2519 Wiretap Report table index,
the Federal Register `documents.json` term search (both the
surveillance-technology sweep and the FAA/CBP aerostat rulemaking lane),
the OMB consolidated 2024 Federal AI Use Case Inventory, the DHS (S)AI
use-case inventory, the ICE 287(g) participating-agencies roster (and the
S3-flagged monthly-encounter PDF index), and the NCES SSOCS dataset
index.

`live_verification=false`: this PR lands the engineering + fixture
surfaces only. Every source stays `ingestion_permitted=false` (HG-03
RB-05 `a`; the ICE monthly-encounters row is additionally S3-flagged
IND-P8) and the operator's OP-26 Wave-D flip under ING-GO-D is the only
route to a live fetch. Not an OM-20 row — no `live` legs ran, no
production mutations.

## Machinery

`connectors/federal_datasets.py` (registered, `bulk_file_download`):
- **Committed inventory** (`data/federal_datasets_targets.toml`,
  `sig.federal-dataset-targets/1`) — 13 targets: 6+1 Federal Register
  term queries (one term per query; the API's Boolean OR is not relied
  on), the OMB CSV, and the publisher index lanes. Fail-closed
  validation: schema, closed source set, kind/adapter agreement,
  declared-host check, sorted unique ids, `expect` markers on index
  rows.
- **Versioned vocabulary** (`data/federal_datasets_vocab.toml`,
  `sig.federal-datasets-vocab/1` v2026.11.13) — the 14-predicate
  allowlist enforced as a hard schema gate (SIG-INGEST-033), forbidden
  predicate genres (no sharing edges, deployment assertions, or person
  predicates), the person-level column-token screen, the committed host
  set, and the per-adapter field maps.
- **Adapters**: `fr_documents` → `federal_register_document:` metadata
  records (doc number/title/html URL/citation/date/agencies — metadata
  only, never the document body); `ai_inventory_csv` → `ai_use_case:`
  records on the file's own numbered columns (topic area and dev stage
  verbatim — a guessed technology slug is never minted); `index_links` →
  `federal_document:` pointer records only; `ice_287g_roster_xlsx` →
  `agency_registry_entry:` records with `us.state_abbr` candidates, the
  landing page's dated-workbook link resolved via the bounded
  `discover_more` continuation (the filename changes each issue — link
  discovery, never a pinned stale name).
- **Screens** — the committed `forbidden_field_tokens` column guard
  refuses a served CSV/XLSX carrying a person-level header before any
  claim is built; `natural_person_signal` on roster agency names drops
  a person-shaped agency to a recorded `federal_record_rejected` row;
  every fetch incl. resolved children checks the committed host set;
  the monthly-encounter PDFs are pointers only — contents never fetched,
  so no per-encounter or person-level row can exist by construction.
- **Honest bounds** — wiretap tables, the DHS component inventories, the
  ICE PDFs and the NCES wave files emit pointer records; the wiretap
  per-jurisdiction aggregates and the DHS full spreadsheet lane land
  under reviewed follow-up captures. Judge/officer names are never
  read (§43.4 S5).
